_comment: DevWebUI's tray-host config, read by misc/lunarwerx-tray.exe (source vendored beside it in
misc/tray-host-native/). This file is the whole per-app surface; the host binary is generic and
shared, exactly as DevWebUI-Tray.ps1's $TrayConfig hashtable was.
Paths are relative to THIS file unless absolute. %VAR% expands an environment variable,
%VAR|fallback% supplies a default, and a leading ~ is the user profile.
_compiled: Release layout (the -with-tray zip): a compiled devwebui.exe sits at the app root, so run THAT
instead of bun + server/src, and don't require bun on PATH at all. A source checkout has no exe
at the root, so this key simply doesn't resolve there and the bun path above stays in force.
Resolving it also disables firstRun, which bootstraps a checkout and has nothing to do in a
bundle that ships everything already built.
_action: DevWebUI supervises WORK the daemon owns (its managed dev servers), so it gets an extra menu
item: Restart and Quit act on the daemon, this acts on what the daemon is running. The request
can take seconds while each child's SIGTERM grace elapses, so the host fires it off-thread.
actionFailText: Couldn't stop everything - open {APP} to check.
